_note: JSE conformance corpus - LOOPS IN EXPRESSION BLOCKS (2026-08-22). A block body (a block-bodied lambda, an IIFE, a <variable>/function body) runs the full loop grammar: classic for (with the authored-locals law - `let i` counts in its own counter), for..of, for..in, while, do..while, and break/continue. Loops are BUDGETED, not banned: one shared 10000-iteration ledger per block evaluation, so a computed body stays total (the budget-stops-a-runaway case pins the cap's existence without pinning the cap). Before this file every loop in a computed/variable body was silently skipped (branch-only blocks) while the SAME statement looped fine in an action body - one grammar, two meanings. Swift = reference (record lane authoritates expected).

cases.name: classic-for-builds-a-series
cases.expression: (() => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { out.push(i * 2) } return out })()

cases.name: classic-for-accumulates
cases.expression: (() => { let total = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) { total += i } return total })()

cases.name: for-of-accumulates
cases.expression: (() => { let s = ''; for (const ch of ['a', 'b', 'c']) { s = s + ch } return s })()

cases.name: for-in-collects-keys
cases.expression: (() => { let ks = ''; for (const k in { a: 1, b: 2 }) { ks = ks + k } return ks })()

cases.name: while-counts-down
cases.expression: (() => { let n = 5; let steps = 0; while (n > 0) { n -= 1; steps += 1 } return steps })()

cases.name: do-while-runs-body-first
cases.expression: (() => { let n = 0; do { n += 1 } while (n < 3) return n })()

cases.name: break-exits-the-loop
cases.expression: (() => { let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { if (i == 7) { break } n += 1 } return n })()

cases.name: continue-skips-an-iteration
cases.expression: (() => { let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { if (i % 2 == 0) { continue } n += 1 } return n })()

cases.name: nested-loops-share-the-budget
cases.expression: (() => { let hits = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { hits += 1 } } return hits })()

cases.name: budget-stops-a-runaway
cases.expression: (() => { let n = 0; while (true) { n += 1; if (n > 20000) { return 'unbounded' } } return 'stopped' })()

cases.name: loop-var-stays-local
cases.expression: (() => { let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { n += i } return n })() + '|' + i

cases.name: reduce-style-map-build-with-loop
cases.expression: (() => { const m = {}; const rows = [{ id: 'a' }, { id: 'b' }]; for (const r of rows) { m[r.id] = 1 } return m })()
